designs.artworkPrompt: Give me an image with a Kin Arcori from the Entelairs lineage named Silvester in chibi style with a standard finish and no effect. The character should have antler-like features, a mystical but friendly appearance, and design elements inspired by the player's chosen customization. Use a background visually related to the Genesis origins of Velora. No borders, no frames. The subject should be horizontally and vertically centered. The subject should fill around 2/4 of the total image size. The image must use a 1:1 aspect ratio in webp format and named KIN-SIL202607092145-GEN001-0001.webp
designs.loreDescription: The first generation of the Silvester lineage. This Genesis Arcori belongs to the Entelairs Kin and marks the beginning of a unique family within Velora.
